title: HB505 (134th Legislature (2021-2022)): Allow carrying concealed deadly weapons without a license

operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.11(S)): "Restricted firearm" means a firearm that is a dangerous ordnance or that is a firearm that any law of this state or the United States prohibits the subject person from possessing, having, or carrying.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.11(T)): "Restricted deadly weapon" means a deadly weapon that is a restricted firearm or that is a deadly weapon that any law of this state or the United States prohibits the subject person from possessing, having, or carrying.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.126(E)(4)): A person who is at least twenty-one years of age and is not prohibited under the law of this state or the United States from possessing a deadly weapon has the same right to carry a concealed deadly weapon that is not a restricted deadly weapon in this state as a person who was issued a concealed weapons license under section 2923.125 of the Revised Code and is subject to the same restrictions as specified in this section.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.12(B)): No person who has been issued a concealed weapons license or who is at least twenty-one years of age and is not prohibited under the law of this state or the United States from possessing a deadly weapon, shall do any of the following.
